item.title: Traffic investigation shuts down Patterson Street at I-40 West in Greensboro
item.description: GREENSBORO, N.C. (WGHP) -- All lanes of Patterson Street at I-40 Westbound in Greensboro are closed due to a traffic investigation, according to a Greensboro Police Department news release. Drivers are asked to avoid the area. The cause for the investigation is unknown at this time. This is a developing story.
